settings.locales.subtitle: 控制翻譯來源、語言顯示，以及執行階段語言環境維護工具。
settings.overlay.sectionVisibilities.foo: Click a button to toggle visibility. Changes are saved per profile.
settings.overlay.sectionVisibilities.sub: Control which parts of the shared overlay are shown for the active profile.
settings.overlay.startWithAppDescription: 當應用啟動且已啟用遮罩發布時，自動打開共享遮罩。
settings.overlay.skillAutoHideDaily: 日常場景自動隱藏技能監控
settings.overlay.skillAutoHideDailyDescr: 啟用技能監控時，進入日常場景黑名單會隱藏共享遮罩，離開後恢復正常顯示狀態。
settings.overlay.monsterAutoHideDaily: 日常場景自動隱藏怪物監控
settings.overlay.monsterAutoHideDailyDes: 啟用怪物監控時，進入日常場景黑名單會隱藏共享遮罩，離開後恢復正常顯示狀態。
settings.overlay.autoHideWithLiveWindowD: 啟用「自動隱藏即時視窗」後，可見的疊加層會隨即時計量表一起隱藏，且只在自動隱藏前原本可見時恢復。
settings.overlay.autoHideWithLiveWindowH: 此選項跟隨即時計量表依傷害判斷的隱藏/顯示流程，不會自行開啟疊加層；關閉「自動隱藏即時視窗」時不會生效。
settings.overlay.skillCdAccelerationDesc: Adds a small acceleration badge and cooldown diagnostic tooltip to Skill CD icons. Useful for checking cooldown reduction and acceleration sources.
settings.overlay.subtitle: 控制哪些監控係統會主動把資料推送到共享懸浮窗。
settings.profile.subtitle: 創建並管理技能監控配置方案，同時配置事件日誌視窗行為和會話日誌存儲。
settings.profile.autoHideWindowsOnGameBl: 遊戲未啟用時隱藏即時視窗和懸浮窗
啟用此配置方案時，若其他應用程式取得焦點，即時計量表和目前可見的懸浮窗會自動隱藏；當 Blue Protocol: Star Resonance 或 Resonance Logs - Global 重新啟用後會恢復。此功能只檢查系統前景視窗，不讀取遊戲記憶體。
settings.profile.highlightDpsHealerSpecI: 高亮 DPS 治療專精
Smite 和 Dissonance 保持治療綠色，並可選擇加入紅色發光，用於在即時和歷史列中標記 DPS 治療定位。
settings.profile.restore8165RoseOrbsTool: Added option to restore 8165 orbs for players affected by scam. This option doesn't do anything. It's just here for the vibes. #NeverForget
settings.profileLibrary.description: Load profile JSON files from a folder. Missing fields are added from the current defaults, and the last selected profile is remembered outside the JSON files.
settings.profileLibrary.noProfiles: No valid profiles were found in that folder.
settings.profileLibrary.reset: Profile library reset to internal profiles.
settings.profileLibrary.title: Profile library folder
settings.selectTabPrompt: 請選擇上方的分頁以查看全域設定

settings.appBehavior.subtitle: 控制不綁定到單一懸浮窗或儀表檢視的全域應用程式行為。
settings.hideMainWindowToTray: 關閉時將主視窗隱藏到系統匣
settings.hideMainWindowToTrayDescription: 啟用後，關閉主視窗會將其隱藏而不是結束。使用系統匣圖示還原，或選擇結束以完全關閉。
settings.discordPresence.title: Discord Rich Presence
settings.discordPresence.description: Publish your current scene, boss, true DPS timer, personal DPS, and deaths to Discord when Discord is running.
settings.discordPresence.rateLimitToolti: Discord rate-limits Rich Presence updates, so Resonance Logs sends meaningful changes at a paced interval instead of every DPS tick. Combat and death updates are limited to about every 5 seconds, idle updates are slower, and duplicate states are skipped so Discord is less likely to ignore bursts.
settings.discordPresence.enabledDescript: Shows Resonance Logs activity in Discord while Discord is running. Presence is cleared when this is disabled.
settings.discordPresence.dpsMetricDescri: Choose whether Discord shows your DPS or true DPS.
